name: mermaid-diagram
title: MermaidDiagram
description: Opt-in diagrams: install the pinned optional peer mermaid@12.2.0 and import MermaidDiagram or mermaidCodeRenderers from @gntik-ai/chat/mermaid. Pass the stable map to Markdown codeRenderers; it renders closed fences even while the reply streams, and leaves incomplete fences as code. The main chat entry never loads Mermaid. Rendering is client-only: SSR and loading show CodeBlock, followed by a Rendering diagram… status. The first complete diagram dynamically imports mermaid from the consumer app’s own chunk; no CDN is used. Strict CSP apps must allow the generated SVG’s inline styles or keep the code view. Strict security, disabled HTML labels, locked configuration and a second SVG sanitiser remove scripts, HTML foreign objects, event handlers, animation and external resources. Invalid sources fall back to code and Could not render the diagram. Colours read neutral surface and contrast-safe foreground tokens on every theme change. code is required; streaming defaults to false; defaultView is diagram; onViewChange reports user view changes; label defaults to the translated Diagram; className styles the figure. The toolbar toggles diagram/code (aria-pressed), copies source, downloads sanitised diagram.svg and adjusts zoom; drag pans. No canvas transitions run, including under reduced motion. MermaidDiagramReply demonstrates Markdown integration; MermaidDiagramStates shows code-first, custom label, className, callback, failure, streaming and Spanish strings. Full-screen viewing and PNG export are deferred.
author: gntik-ai

import { tokenHex } from '@gntik-ai/tokens/runtime';

/** Pair foreground text with neutral surfaces in every theme, including high contrast. */
export function themeVariables(): Record<string, string> {
  const surface = tokenHex('secondary');
  const text = tokenHex('foreground');
  const background = tokenHex('background');
  const border = tokenHex('border');
  return {
    background,
    primaryColor: surface,
    primaryTextColor: text,
    primaryBorderColor: border,
    secondaryColor: surface,
    secondaryTextColor: text,
    secondaryBorderColor: border,
    tertiaryColor: background,
    tertiaryTextColor: text,
    tertiaryBorderColor: border,
    textColor: text,
    lineColor: text,
    mainBkg: surface,
    nodeBorder: border,
    clusterBkg: background,
    clusterBorder: border,
    edgeLabelBackground: background,
    actorBkg: surface,
    actorBorder: border,
    actorTextColor: text,
    signalColor: text,
    signalTextColor: text,
    labelBoxBkgColor: surface,
    labelBoxBorderColor: border,
    labelTextColor: text,
    loopTextColor: text,
    noteBkgColor: surface,
    noteTextColor: text,
    noteBorderColor: border,
    activationBkgColor: surface,
    activationBorderColor: border,
  };
}

import { interpolate, useI18n, type MessageKey, type MessageVars } from '@gntik-ai/ui';

/**
 * English fallbacks for the chat keys added after the first `@gntik-ai/ui` release. The
 * strings live in the ui catalogs (en + es); these keep the pack readable when it runs
 * against an older `@gntik-ai/ui` whose catalog does not have them yet.
 */
const FALLBACK = {
  'chat.diagramFailed': 'Could not render the diagram',
  'chat.showDiagram': 'Show diagram',
  'chat.showCode': 'Show code',
  'chat.downloadSvg': 'Download SVG',
  'chat.zoomIn': 'Zoom in',
  'chat.zoomOut': 'Zoom out',
  'chat.resetZoom': 'Reset zoom',
  'chat.diagram': 'Diagram',
  'chat.renderingDiagram': 'Rendering diagram…',
  'chat.surfaceExampleTitle': 'Review your details',
  'chat.surfaceExampleName': 'Name',
  'chat.surfaceExampleSubmit': 'Submit',
  'chat.surfaceExampleChoice': 'Language',
  'chat.surfaceExampleEnglish': 'English',
  'chat.surfaceExampleSpanish': 'Spanish',
  'chat.surfaceExampleNotify': 'Send updates',
  'chat.surfaceExampleBadge': 'Draft',
  'chat.surfaceExampleNotice': 'Check the information before submitting.',
  'chat.surfaceExampleStatus': 'Submitted for {name}',
  'chat.surfaceExamplePatch': 'Update name',
  'chat.surfaceExampleRemove': 'Remove content',
  'chat.surfaceExampleReset': 'Reset',
  'chat.surfaceExampleUnsupported': 'Show unsupported content',
  'chat.surfaceExampleRejected': 'Unsupported content was rejected.',
  'chat.surfaceExampleLink': 'Read the documentation',
  'chat.surfaceUnsupported': 'This content cannot be shown',
  'chat.surfaceAgentContent': 'Agent content',
  'chat.typing': '{author} is typing',
  'chat.feedback': 'Response feedback',
  'chat.feedbackTitle': 'What went wrong?',
  'chat.feedbackReason': 'Reason',
  'chat.feedbackComment': 'Comment (optional)',
  'chat.feedbackPlaceholder': 'Tell us more…',
  'chat.feedbackSubmit': 'Send feedback',
  'chat.feedbackThanks': 'Thanks for your feedback',
  'chat.feedbackCleared': 'Feedback removed',
  'chat.reasonInaccurate': 'Inaccurate',
  'chat.reasonUnhelpful': 'Not helpful',
  'chat.reasonIncomplete': 'Incomplete',
  'chat.reasonUnsafe': 'Harmful or unsafe',
  'chat.reasonOther': 'Other',
  'chat.regenerate': 'Regenerate',
  'chat.uploading': 'Uploading {name}',
  'chat.uploadFailed': 'Upload failed',
  'chat.retryUpload': 'Retry uploading {name}',
  'chat.dropFiles': 'Drop files to attach',
  'chat.fileTooLarge': '{name} is larger than {max}',
  'chat.fileTypeNotAllowed': '{name} is not an allowed file type',
  'chat.tooManyFiles': 'You can attach up to {max} files',
  'chat.model': 'Model',

  'chat.capabilityAudio': 'Audio',
  'chat.contextWindow': '{size} context',
  'chat.unavailable': 'Unavailable',
} as const;

export type ChatMessageKey = keyof typeof FALLBACK;

/** `useI18n()` plus `tc()`, a translator for the newer chat keys with English fallbacks. */
export function useChatI18n() {
  const i18n = useI18n();
  const tc = (key: ChatMessageKey, vars?: MessageVars) => {
    const out = i18n.t(key as MessageKey, vars);
    return out === key ? interpolate(FALLBACK[key], vars, i18n.locale) : out;
  };
  return { ...i18n, tc };
}
